For the best result, install it into pre-moistened soil after soaking the sensor in water for 15 minutes. Place the ceramic cone roughly halfway down the soil profile, no deeper than about 6 inches, and keep the drippers spread around the root zone instead of clustered right beside the sensor.

If you chose a 9 inch sensor, you do not need to bury the full length. After setup, give it 24 to 48 hours before judging performance or making small adjustments. If you want, tell us which version you bought and your pot size, and we can give you the best setup for that exact configuration.
